{"reason": "v1's 0.714 false-arbitration-rate comes from low-confidence changes passing the pct/exposure gates; 6 of 8 failure rows have confidence < 0.7 (0.44–0.67). Adding a high-confidence? condition to the and removes these false arbitrations, lowering the rate, while confidence ≥ 0.7 rows (recall) should stay near the 0.8 business gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
